title: Godot crashes in debug mode when removing breakpoint using DAP
body:
### Tested versions

4.4.1.stable.voidlinux

### System information

Kernel: 6.15.9_1 arch: x86_64 bits: 64 Desktop: Sway v: 0.5.3 Distro: Void Linux / Graphics: Device-1: Advanced Micro Devices [AMD/ATI] Barcelo driver: amdgpu


### Issue description

I am using neovim as external editor and debugger. After starting a debugging session using the DAP debugger, everything works as expected. Any breakpoint I have added will be hit and I can step in/over normally.
The problem is if I remove a breakpoint during debugging godot just crashes.

### Steps to reproduce

#### Editor settings
Text editor -> External
  -> Exec Path: /usr/bin/nvim
  -> Exec Flags:   --server /tmp/godot.pipe --remote-send "<esc>:n {file}<CR>:call cursor({line},{col})<CR>"
  -> Use external editor: On

#### Network
  -> Debug -> Remote port: 6006
  -> Debug -> Sync breakpoints: On (I have tried with both On and Off, there seems to be no difference)
  -> Debug adapter -> Remote Port: 6007

I've been mostly debugging the `scripts.camera_controller._input` function. Run the project with a couple of breakpoints in the file, then during debug session remove a breakpoint.
